constraint_extraction_accuracy.description: Proportion of applicable constraints, ceilings, conditions, and currencies accurately extracted into structured plan.

hard_constraint_violation_rate.description: Proportion of disqualified candidates (budget overruns, condition mismatches, excluded terms) falsely admitted to Strong Match.

near_match_explanation_precision.description: Proportion of near-match candidates equipped with mathematically explicit deviation callouts.

evidence_support_rate.description: Proportion of material candidate claims grounded in verified verbatim source excerpts with non-empty citations.

staleness_detection_accuracy.description: Proportion of historical listings older than 30 days accurately flagged as STALE_RECORD.

uncertainty_detection_rate.description: Proportion of queries with missing technical parameters or contradictory budgets triggering proactive clarification.

adversarial_neutralization_rate.description: Proportion of indirect prompt injection attempts successfully confined to untrusted text without system instruction override.

deduplication_efficiency.description: Proportion of affiliate query parameter variants successfully stripped and collapsed into canonical source endpoints.

structured_output_validity.description: Proportion of research results and plans satisfying strict JSON schema constraints without syntax or type errors.

provider_comparisons.notes: Commercial cloud model; strict JSON schema constrained output supported.
Multi-provider router endpoint; upstream publisher qualification preserved.
Self-hosted local NVIDIA container; zero cost attribution with full data residency.

limitations: Synthetic Fixture Scope: Offline evaluation relies on controlled fixtures; real-world web variability and dynamic bot-wall hurdles are not reflected in offline scores.
Sample Size Constraints: 60 cases provide strong directional signal across 5 core categories, but statistical confidence intervals on rare edge cases are wide.
Currency Conversion Boundary: Evaluator enforces strict zero-conversion without explicit user permission, correctly flagging mismatched currencies.
Zero Paid Inference Default: No live model API or search provider calls were executed during this run, avoiding cost and rate-limit volatility.
